driver: The gain a specialist team adds to a unit is its effect on the reachable volume the unit does not already treat itself, because the unit's own past trials, which supply the measured effect, have already banked their gains in the volume carried forward; every closed deployment went to units that had never run a trial of their own, so the shrunk effect times reachable volume reproduces all of them, while the unit leading on that basis already treats the items that carry most of its reachable volume and a unit that has treated little of its own overtakes it.
driver_concrete: Desk editors already test headlines through the self-serve tool and every winner they ship is already in the clicks the audience plan carries forward, so the squad adds only on the platform-drawn clicks of headlines the desk does not test itself; the squad's seven closed embeddings were all in app-exclusive desks that had never run a test of their own, so shrunk lift times platform-drawn clicks reproduces every one, while Local·metro, which leads on that basis, already tests the headlines that carry most of its platform clicks.
stump: A competent solver rebuilds each desk's winning lift from the test archive, shrinks it as the seven closed embeddings require, counts only the clicks that start on surfaces that show the tested headline, and names Local·metro; the step that lands them there is never asking who ran the tests behind each desk's lift, which the archive's test owners joined to the newsroom staff list answer: Local·metro's own editors already test the headlines that carry most of its platform clicks, so most of the gain the squad was sized on is already in the plan.
